info.software: Real-time GitHub star counts, total repository volume, and 30-day momentum metrics for programming languages, popular frameworks, libraries, and database technologies.
info.security: GitHub star trends and community activity stats for top open-source cybersecurity tools and frameworks (Ghidra, Metasploit, Nmap, OWASP ZAP, etc.). These tools are provided for educational and research purposes within ethical and legal boundaries (security research, pentesting, CTF challenges, and system defense).
